explanation: I read the library's file (GroupTheory/GroupAction/Centralizer.lean) and searched Mathlib (commit 83abb3e776bd) for anything stating that pretransitivity of the centralizer of the range of `MulAction.toPermHom G X` is equivalent to normality of the point stabilizer. Searched `GroupTheory/GroupAction/{Transitive,Primitive,MultipleTransitivity,Quotient,ConjAct}.lean`, `GroupTheory/Perm/{Centralizer,ClosureSwap,Subgroup}.lean`, `GroupTheory/IndexNormal.lean`, `Algebra/Group/Action/End.lean`, and grepped for `centralizer.*stabilizer`, `centralizer (Set.range ...)`, `stabilizer.*Normal`, `normalizerQuotient`, `IsPretransitive.*centralizer` etc. Mathlib has the ingredients (`MulAction.isPretransitive_iff_base`, `IsPretransitive.of_orbit`, `exists_smul_eq`, `stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj`, `MulAction.toPermHom`) but no declaration with this content (its notion of `MulAction.stabilizer`, `IsPretransitive`, and the normalizer-quotient/centralizer identification used in the proof — `MulAction.normalizerQuotientEquivAut` — is library-local, not in Mathlib). Hence no duplicate and no one-line specialization applies.
